command_menu.title: Search Pleadli Police
command_menu.description: Search people, cases, custody, statements, and everything else across the station.
command_menu.placeholder: Search by name, NIN, phone, case number, reference…
command_menu.hint: Type to search across the whole station.

attachments.label: Attachments
attachments.save_first: Save this record first, then you can attach files.

validation.enter_the_address_of_the_command: Enter the address of the command.
validation.enter_the_station_number_the_command_gav: Enter the station number the command gave this station.
validation.choose_an_officer_or_enter_a_name: Choose an officer or enter a name.
validation.shift_end_must_be_after_shift_start: Shift end must be after shift start.
validation.lowercase_letters_numbers_and_hyphens_on: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
validation.password_must_be_at_least_8_characters: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.a_badge_number_is_needed_to_sign_in: A badge number is needed to sign in.
validation.the_administrator_needs_a_badge_number: The administrator needs a badge number.

bonds.reporting_placeholder: e.g. Report every Monday until further notice
bonds.reporting_hint: Free text: no standard schedule format was confirmed in research.

cases.reference_hint: Leave the reference blank to take the next number in the Crime Record Book.

command.overview_lead: What the stations under this command last reported. Figures and rosters only: no case, person or custody record ever reaches this command.
command.near_or_past_caption: {past} past it, {near} within hours of it
command.empty_no_stations: No station is registered yet. Register one under Stations.
command.empty_all_good: Nothing needs attention. Every connected station is reporting and no one is past the custody limit.
command.one_waiting: A station is waiting to be approved
command.many_waiting: {count} stations are waiting to be approved
command.past_limit_summary: {count} in custody past the limit, reported {when}. Call the station.
command.silent_summary: No report for {duration}. The figures below for this station are not current, so they are left out of the totals.
command.listener_description: A station enters this address, and the station number from the Stations page, in its own Settings.
command.listener_hint: The connection is not encrypted yet. Use it on a network this command controls.
command.listener_no_address: This computer has no network address. Connect it to the network first.
command.register_hint: The station is given a number here. It connects from its own Settings using that number.
command.revoke_confirm: Revoke {name}? It will stop being accepted and must connect again.
command.stations_lead: The stations under this command and what each last reported. A station sends figures and its roster; this command never holds its records.
command.register_description: Give a station a number so it can connect to this command.
command.request_summary: Asked to connect {when} by {name}, badge {badge}, from {from}. Approve it only if that is someone you expect.
command.code_description: Give this to the station's administrator. It connects the station without waiting for approval, works once, and expires {expires}. It is shown only now.
command.roster_description: As the station last reported them{when}. Names and posts only.

custody.past_limit: {name} is past the constitutional custody limit.
custody.approaching_limit: {name} is approaching the constitutional custody limit.
custody.nobody: No one is recorded in custody.
custody.cross_jurisdiction: Cross-jurisdiction transfer (arrested outside the station's area)
custody.transfer_hint: The Police Act allows up to 7 days to transfer a suspect arrested outside the station's jurisdiction; the 48-hour clock applies once here.

basis.transfer_window: the 7 day transfer window from the arrest
basis.post_transfer: 48 hours from the transfer (inferred, not confirmed)

command_link.title: Command
command_link.admin_only: Only an administrator can change this.
command_link.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect from the command? It will stop receiving this station's reports.
command_link.asked_by: Asked by {name}. An administrator at the command has to approve it. This page checks every 20 seconds.
command_link.connected_first: Connected. The first report goes out within a minute.
command_link.rejected: The command does not accept this station. Disconnect and connect again, or ask the command.
command_link.what_is_sent: This station sends its command counts (people in custody, near the limit, open cases, referrals without an outcome, officers on duty) and its roster of officers. It never sends a case, a person, a statement or a password.
command_link.connect_description: Connect this station to the command (HQ) it reports to. The command gives the station a number, and may give an activation code.
command_link.not_encrypted: The connection is not encrypted yet; use it on a network the command controls.
command_link.admin_only_connect: Only an administrator can connect the station.
command_link.address_hint: The address and port the command shows on its Settings.

data_io.vault_exported_desc: Every record, regenerated fresh and zipped.
data_io.export_all_desc: Every record this station has entered, in one file, organized the same way the Police Vault already is on disk. Markdown is the default; Excel, PDF, and Word give the same data in those formats.
data_io.bulk_desc: Bring in an existing stack of paperwork for one person or case at once: scanned files, old register photos, typed reports. Everything lands in the same Vault folder a single attachment for that record already would.

import.read_failed_desc: Check it is a valid CSV or Excel file.
import.resolve_failed: Could not resolve people or cases
import.title: Import records
import.desc: Bring existing police work in from a CSV or Excel file: pick the record type, map its columns to real fields, confirm who each row belongs to, then import.
import.step1_desc: What kind of record does each row in your file represent?
import.step2_desc: A CSV or Excel file, one row per record, with a header row.
import.step3_desc_one: 1 row detected. Match each field to a column in your file, or leave it ignored.
import.step3_desc: {count} rows detected. Match each field to a column in your file, or leave it ignored.
import.step4_desc: Every name and case reference below needs a real record to attach to. Matches are suggested, never assumed: check each one.
import.new_despite: Will create a new person despite similar existing records.
import.no_match_new: No existing match found; will create a new person.
import.step5_desc_one: Ready to import 1 record. This cannot be undone automatically; review before confirming.
import.step5_desc: Ready to import {count} records. This cannot be undone automatically; review before confirming.

charge_sheet.draw_failed: Could not draw up charge sheet
charge_sheet.particulars_placeholder: Time, place, conduct, and subject matter. Only what's necessary to give the accused reasonable notice of the charge.
charge_sheet.heading: Charge · PF 53

officers.link_placeholder: Link this officer's own person record
officers.keep_password: Leave blank to keep the current password
officers.password_hint: A password lets this officer sign in over remote access from a phone. It needs a badge number. Leave it blank for an officer who only appears on the books.
officers.active: Currently at this station (off for an officer who has left)
officers.not_on_books: Someone not on the station books

backup.needs: {name} needs backup. Not yet responded to.

attention.empty: Nothing needs attention. No one in custody is near the limit and no referral is waiting.
attention.past_summary: Past the limit by {time}. Arrested {when}. The limit was {deadline}.
attention.referral_summary: Record what came back, or follow it up with the office it was sent to.

overview.suspect_one: 1 suspect is at or near the 48-hour constitutional limit.
overview.suspect_n: {count} suspects are at or near the 48-hour constitutional limit.
overview.title: Station Overview

referrals.destination_placeholder: e.g. Resident State Attorney, Buganda Road

dev.switch_failed_desc: The switch did not go through.
dev.title: Dev builds only: switch between Station and Command

pre_auth.station_headline: One station, every record in one place.
pre_auth.station_body: Diary, cases, custody and statements, kept on this computer and working without a network.
pre_auth.command_body: A command holds no case or person records, only what its stations choose to report up.
pre_auth.neutral_body: Pleadli Police is built for the officer at the desk: offline first, with nothing to sign up for.
pre_auth.setting_up_desc: Saving your details and opening the workspace. This can take a minute the first time. Please keep this window open.
pre_auth.signing_in_desc: Checking your badge and opening the workspace. This screen would otherwise sit blank while that happens, so it says so instead.
pre_auth.waiting_desc: Pleadli Police could not reach its own data. If it keeps failing, restart the application.

sign_in.title: Sign in
sign_in.command_desc: {name} needs a badge number and a password.
sign_in.password_desc: {name} needs your badge number and password.
sign_in.badge_desc: {name}: type your badge number. It says who is at the keyboard; it is not a secret.
sign_in.failed: It could not sign you in.

onboarding.title: Set up this installation
onboarding.desc: Choose what this computer is. This is decided once and cannot be changed later.
onboarding.station_desc: Every record for one station. Officers sign in with a badge number.
onboarding.command_desc: A district, region or headquarters. Only what its stations report. Badge and password.
onboarding.existing_hint: The officers already recorded here. The administrator changes settings and adds officers.
onboarding.err_badge: The administrator needs a badge number.
onboarding.who_runs_password: The first administrator. Everyone here signs in with a badge number and a password.
onboarding.who_runs_badge: The first administrator. Officers sign in with a badge number; an administrator can require passwords later, in Settings.
onboarding.name_station_desc: This is printed on every register, statement and charge sheet. Where it sits in the force is optional.
onboarding.name_command_desc: The district, region or headquarters this computer serves.
onboarding.level_hint: A suggestion for how this command is described. It changes nothing else.

sign_in_settings.title: Sign-in
sign_in_settings.command_desc: A command always needs a badge number and a password. This cannot be changed.
sign_in_settings.station_desc: What an officer needs to sign in at this station. A badge number says who is at the keyboard; it is not a secret. Turn on passwords for a machine that others can reach.
sign_in_settings.next_sign_in: Changes apply to the next sign-in.
sign_in_settings.sign_out_after: Sign out after no activity for
sign_in_settings.password_note: Every officer then needs a password, set on the Officers page. An officer with none cannot sign in until an administrator gives them one.
sign_in_settings.trail_desc: Every sign-in, refusal, sign-out and change to these settings, newest first.

shift_log.no_officer: No officer with that badge number.
shift_log.check_in_desc: Type a badge number, or an officer can check in themselves from the remote app (Settings > Remote Access has the QR).

assets.held_by_placeholder: Officer or unit currently holding it

units.save_failed: Could not save the command structure
units.blank_hint: Leave a level blank if it does not apply to this station.

quick.diary_desc: Record what has been reported or done at the station.
quick.incident_desc: An occurrence reported to or found by the station.
quick.custody_desc: Someone taken into custody. The 48 hour clock starts from the arrest.
quick.person_desc: Someone who appears in the station records.

evidence_page.title: Evidence & Exhibits
evidence_page.add_desc: Record an item recovered, with its chain of custody.
evidence_page.lead: Exhibit identity and traceability. Distinct from Stores/Armory, which is station equipment, not case evidence.
evidence_page.edit_desc: Update this exhibit and its custody log.
evidence_page.search: Search exhibits by description, ID mark, or storage location…

incidents_page.lead: Something that happened or was reported.

intake_page.title: Case Intake
intake_page.add_desc: Start formal handling of a matter.
intake_page.lead: Formal police handling of a matter: one dimension among several, not the root everything else hangs off.

investigation.list_lead: Pick a case to open its working view: people, statements, custody, bonds, and files, brought together in one place.

legal_page.title: Charge Sheets & Forms
legal_page.add_desc: PF53, generated from data already in Pleadli.
legal_page.lead: Generated from Case and Person data already in the system. Only the offence, statutory section, and particulars are new.
legal_page.empty: No charge sheets drawn up yet.
legal_page.search: Search by offence, case reference, or accused…

logs.backup_lead: Every "request backup" call from a remote session, with the officer's location at the moment it was sent.
logs.lead: What's happened over remote access: backup requests and every search or check made from outside this desktop. Local use is never logged here, since it never leaves this device.
logs.remote_lead: Every search, detail view, and custody-alert check made from outside the desktop app. Local use is never logged here.

referrals_page.title: Referrals & Dispatches
referrals_page.add_desc: Hand a case to DPP, Courts, or another station.
referrals_page.lead: One workflow, not two: case handed elsewhere, tracked here. Emergency/operational dispatch is a different concern this app doesn't model.
referrals_page.search: Search by case reference or destination…

reports.title: Reports & Analytics
reports.lead: How the station is doing over time. Derived entirely from existing records, nothing tracked separately. Overview answers what needs attention right now; this answers the trend.
reports.diary_desc: Entries logged per week, last {weeks} weeks.
reports.intake_desc: Cases opened per week, last {weeks} weeks.
reports.custody_desc: Arrests logged per week, last {weeks} weeks.
reports.statements_desc: Statements taken per week, last {weeks} weeks.
reports.top_offences_desc: Most common offences on charge sheets.

roster.title: Duty Roster
roster.add_desc: Who is on duty, and when.
roster.handover_desc: Who took over, and what happened.
roster.lead: Officer assignments and shift coverage at this station.

sd_page.title: Station Diary
sd_page.add_desc: Log what happened. This doesn't have to become an incident.
sd_page.lead: Station activity, logged as it happens. Most entries stay informational.

bonds_page.title: Bonds & sureties
bonds_page.add_desc: Record a police bond, mirroring the PF18 form's fields.
bonds_page.lead: Police bond, distinct from court bail: granted here, not by a magistrate.

custody_page.lead: Who is in the cells, soonest limit first. Each limit is worked out from the arrest time when this page is drawn, never stored, so it cannot drift out of date.
custody_page.new_desc: Log an arrest and start the 48-hour clock.

files.open_record_aria: Open the record this file belongs to
files.open_failed: Could not open the record this file belongs to
files.title: Files
files.lead: The Police Vault itself. Every record generates its own folder here, on this device's Documents, and every file attached anywhere in the app lives in the matching one.

people_page.lead: Find a person, or add one if they aren't known to the system yet.
people_page.search: Search people by name, phone, or national ID…

brand.title: Logo
brand.description: Shown in the sidebar, the splash and the sign-in screen. Use your institution's own crest.
brand.hint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP, up to 1 MB. Kept on this computer.

settings.language_desc: The language of this app on this computer.
settings.appearance_desc: Light, dark, or match the system.
settings.custody_alerts_desc: A native notification when an in-custody record approaches or passes its 48h/7d deadline.
settings.dev_mode_desc: Dev builds only. Flips this installation to try both. A Command signs in with a password, so your account needs one first.
settings.keep_token: Leave blank to keep the current token
settings.remote_live: Live at {host}, and reachable on this station's local network.
settings.remote_local: On for this station's local network. Configure Cloudflare below for access from anywhere.
settings.remote_off: Off. Nothing outside this desktop app can reach station data.
settings.reachable_at: Reachable at {address} on this network. Same QR an officer scans to check in.
settings.tunnel_desc: Makes this station reachable from anywhere, not just its own network.
settings.about_lead: Pleadli Police is an offline-first desktop app for station operations, custody compliance, and case work.
settings.about_body: All data is stored locally on this device by default. Station identity and officers are configured under Station administration. An officer's remote sign-in is optional and is set on the Officers page; remote access itself is turned on under the Network tab.
settings.lead: Preferences for this device. Nothing here is shared or synced.

statements_page.add_desc: What was said, by whom, and taken by whom.
statements_page.lead: First-class records with their own accountability, not text attached to a case.

station_page.title: Station administration
station_page.lead: What station this is, and who works here. Not shift scheduling (Duty roster) and not equipment (Armory, Impounded assets).

officers_page.lead: Everyone who works at this station: {here} at the station, {left} left. The roster, statements and charge sheets choose from this list. A remote sign-in is optional.
officers_page.add_desc: Someone who works at this station.
officers_page.search: Search by name, rank, post or badge number

profile_page.title: Station Profile
profile_page.lead: What station this is. The canonical source PF53 and Overview both read from.
profile_page.structure_desc: The region, district and division this station sits in.
profile_page.not_recorded: Not recorded. Add the region and district so this station can be placed in the structure.

stores.title: Stores & Armory
stores.lead: Everything the station holds: weapons and equipment, and property impounded from the public. Sort or filter here, or go to a specific register below.
stores.search: Search across armory and impounded assets…
stores.armory_desc: Weapons and equipment held by the station.
stores.impounded_desc: Property impounded and held by the station.

vehicles_page.add_desc: Record a plate number, and its owner if known.
vehicles_page.lead: Look someone up by their vehicle, or a vehicle up by its plate.
vehicles_page.search: Search by plate, make, or model…
